name: agy
description: Use the Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) from Claude Code: /agy:ask, /agy:review, /agy:adversarial-review, /agy:scrape, /agy:doc-to-md (read-only: agy pinned to Default mode, outside your repo), /agy:rescue and /agy:image (write-capable, with rails), /agy:status, /agy:result, /agy:cancel, /agy:delegate, /agy:research, /agy:setup, /agy:help.
